items.title: Рассекая небосвод
items.alt: Gu An / GuAn / One Slash to the Heavens GuAn 一斩苍穹
items.description: In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens. (Source: Youku)
